title: Uniform Multi-Select Inspectors
description: Bring every technology playground Inspection tab to batch-editable multi-select with inheritance-ordered field groups (specific first, general last).
summary: Implemented batch multi-select inspector upgrades for GIS map, presentation tile, shooting, and trinity play surfaces using shared uiInspector* helpers. Added batch patch commands (patchPositions/patchRoutes, patchTileCrops/renameTiles, patchShots/patchAssets, patchTrinityNodes) and extended vitest coverage in each play module. Updated framework playground renderer for shooting multi-select API and trinity inspector controllerId.
